title: Text files
summary: Opening files with `with`, modes and encodings, reading line by line, writing and appending, and pathlib.
hints: Open text files with `with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:` so they are closed even if something fails. Iterating `for line in f:` gives one line at a time, each still ending in `"\n"`. `count_lines`: count the lines where `line.strip()` is non-empty.

`longest_line`: `max((line.rstrip("\n") for line in f), key=len, default="")`. `write_lines`: mode `"w"` creates or truncates; write `line + "\n"` for each. `append_line`: mode `"a"` adds to the end and creates the file if it is missing.

`list_files`: `sorted(p.name for p in Path(folder).iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix == suffix)`. `replace_in_file`: `text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")`, `count = text.count(old)`, then `write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")` and return `count`.
